result.reason: Bounded unit repair requires contract revision

failed_units.hypothesis: The reported missing restored account (Story_L12_04) and lost persisted reconciliation task (Story_L12_10) violate explicit durable-state requirements and belong to ECON's LobbyEconomy persistence path. Rendering, safe-area, preview and navigation failures require separate SHELL-owned repairs, not expanded ECON ownership. The supplied requirements already define these behaviors; no contract change is needed. The nonbehavioral-evidence violation prevents treating this receipt as established TDD execution evidence.

The supplied failures identify runtime behavior defects, chiefly in SHELL-owned LobbyShellBindings.cs: matching status is not restored for an existing queue, Loading creates only text rather than a loading graphic, and Refresh clears an in-flight invitation confirmation when the invitation closes, preventing 队伍已满 feedback. These require repairs by the declared implementation owners, not expanded MATCH ownership or a contract change. The nonbehavioral-evidence violation does not establish behavioral TDD and requires valid execution evidence.

The evidence shows unmet runtime requirements: inaccessible Menu/row pointer targets, missing rendered content, incorrect safe-area geometry and records lost after restart. These behaviors are already specified and have declared implementation owners. SHELL owns navigation/rendering repairs; ECON owns the shared persistence path called by RECORDS. Peer-owned failures do not expand RECORDS ownership or require a contract change. The nonbehavioral-evidence violation prevents claiming verified TDD, but does not negate the supplied implementation failures.

The supplied source shows failures within the existing SHELL contract: OpenAsync pushes duplicate Appearance routes, so Back can remain on Appearance instead of returning to Lobby; ApplyViewport skips resizing root canvases, undermining the supplied pixel safe-area mapping; and RenderLobby hides Tier3 and later cards when more than two positions from selection. These match reported navigation and geometry failures and require repairs in owned runtime code, not expanded ownership or weakened tests. Persistence, payment reconciliation and fake-match setup failures must be routed separately to their declared service owners. The nonbehavioral-evidence violation does not establish successful TDD, and the earlier compile-only receipt proves no behavioral result. Human visual acceptance remains pending.

The reported failures concern required runtime behavior: missing pointer targets, invisible text, incorrect layout/navigation, and absent match or persistence results. Source corroborates presentation defects: LayoutRows centers all message rows despite required opposite alignment. These repairs belong to the declared implementation owners, primarily SHELL for presentation and MATCH for queue behavior; they do not expand SOCIAL ownership. The nonbehavioral verification receipt cannot establish TDD or current behavioral success, but does not justify changing the contract.
